payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the model utilizes visual contexts to improve its predictions of named entities, suggesting that it inspects how image parts relate to words.

claims.text: The model successfully predicts tokens as named entities by using visual contexts to disambiguate meanings, indicating it inspects the association between image parts and words.
The modality attention module amplifies relevant visual contexts, confirming that the model inspects and utilizes visual information to enhance predictions.
The approach incorporates visual contexts for named entity recognition, demonstrating an inspection of how image parts relate to textual entities.
